Application.description: Represents a monitored application perspective in Instana, composed of observable services

relationships.description: An Instana Application is composed of one or more Services (core model)
Application exposes latency metrics
Application exposes throughput metrics
Application has associated synthetic monitors
Application emits log data
Application emits general metrics
Application emits distributed traces

Service.description: A discrete observable service surfaced by Instana, derived from Container Workloads in the core model

relationships.description: Service composes an Instana Application
Service is surfaced from a Container Workload (core model)
Service emits metrics
Service emits traces

Latency.description: Latency metric observed for an Instana-monitored application or service

relationships.description: Latency is scoped to an Application

Throughput.description: Throughput metric observed for an Instana-monitored application or service

relationships.description: Throughput is scoped to an Application

Synthetics.description: Synthetic monitoring check associated with an Instana Application

relationships.description: Synthetics belong to an Application

Logs.description: Log data emitted by services and workloads monitored by Instana

relationships.description: Logs are scoped to an Application
Logs are emitted by a Service

Metrics.description: General resource and service metrics collected by Instana (covers ResourceMetrics and ServiceMetrics subtypes)

relationships.description: Metrics are scoped to an Application
Metrics are emitted by Container Workloads

Traces.description: Distributed trace data collected by Instana across services

relationships.description: Traces are scoped to an Application
Traces are emitted per Service

Application.description: Represents an application managed in Concert, linked to an environment for deployment-scoped governance

relationships.description: Concert Application is deployed in a Concert Environment
Application is associated with CVE vulnerabilities via container images
Application is derived from build artifacts
Application is tracked via ITSM records
Application may receive patches
Application resilience is expressed through Resilience Metrics

Environment.description: A Concert-managed deployment environment scoping applications and access points

relationships.description: Environment contains one or more Concert Applications
Environment exposes access points (ingress/endpoints)

AccessPoints.description: Network entry points (endpoints/ingress) scoped to a Concert Environment

relationships.description: Access points belong to a Concert Environment

SourceCode.description: Source code repository tracked by Concert as input to the software supply chain

relationships.description: Source code is built via CI/CD pipelines
Source code is stored in code repositories

CodeRepos.description: Code repository entities managed in Concert representing the source origin of artifacts

relationships.description: Code repos store source code
Code repos feed into CI/CD pipelines

CICDPipelines.description: CI/CD pipeline definitions that build and deliver software artifacts from source to deployment

relationships.description: CI/CD pipelines produce build artifacts
Pipelines consume source code

BuildArtifact.description: Executable, config file, or deployable artifact produced by a CI/CD pipeline and tracked by Concert

relationships.description: Build artifact is produced by a CI/CD pipeline
Build artifacts are packaged into container images
Build artifacts may carry CVE vulnerabilities

CVEVulnerability.description: A recorded CVE security vulnerability associated with a Concert image or build artifact

relationships.description: CVE is linked to a specific build artifact or image
CVE is associated with a container image in the core model
CVE may be remediated by a Patch

ITSMData.description: ITSM (IT Service Management) records such as change tickets and service requests associated with Concert-managed components

relationships.description: ITSM records reference Concert-managed applications
ITSM change data feeds into resilience metric computation

IncidentData.description: Incident records tracked by Concert representing operational disruptions affecting applications

relationships.description: Incidents are raised against Concert-managed applications
Incident data contributes to resilience metric computation

Patch.description: A security or maintenance patch tracked by Concert for remediating CVEs in applications

relationships.description: Patch remediates a CVE vulnerability
Patch is applied to an Application

ResilienceMetrics.description: Computed resilience scores for a Concert application component, aggregated from observability and ITSM data

relationships.description: Resilience Metrics are aggregated into a Resilience Profile
ITSM Change Data provides input to Resilience Metrics
Incident Data provides input to Resilience Metrics
Cross-product: Instana Metrics feed into Concert Resilience Metrics computation
Cross-product: Instana Traces feed into Concert Resilience Metrics computation

ResilienceProfile.description: An aggregated resilience profile for a Concert application, summarizing metrics across multiple dimensions

relationships.description: Resilience Profile aggregates multiple Resilience Metrics

ComplianceApplication.description: A Concert compliance-scoped view of an application, tracking regulatory adherence

relationships.description: Compliance Application generates Compliance Reports

ComplianceReports.description: Compliance audit reports generated by Concert for a monitored application or environment

relationships.description: Report is scoped to a Compliance Application

TurboApplication.description: Represents an application entity managed in Turbonomic, composed of services for optimization

relationships.description: Turbo Application is composed of Services from the core model
Turbo Application is acted upon by Optimization Actions

ResourceUsages.description: Resource utilization data (CPU, memory, storage) collected by Turbonomic for infrastructure optimization

relationships.description: Resource Usages feed into Optimization Policy evaluation

ServiceMetrics.description: Service-level performance metrics tracked by Turbonomic as input to optimization decisions

relationships.description: Service Metrics feed into Optimization Policy evaluation

OptimizationPolicy.description: A policy in Turbonomic that governs resource optimization decisions based on usage and service metrics

relationships.description: Policy is fed by Resource Usages
Policy is fed by Service Metrics
Policy generates Optimization Actions

OptimizationAction.description: A recommended or executed infrastructure action generated by Turbonomic to optimize resource utilization

relationships.description: Action is generated by an Optimization Policy
Cross-product: Action acts on a Container Workload in the core model

TerraformTemplate.description: An Infrastructure-as-Code template (HCL/Terraform configuration) that defines and provisions cloud infrastructure resources

relationships.description: Terraform Template governs the provisioning of Clusters
Terraform Template governs provisioning of Nodes
Terraform Template defines Container Workload specifications
Terraform Template defines Services exposed in the infrastructure
Terraform Template provisions Volumes
Terraform Template defines Access Points (load balancers, ingress)
Terraform Template references Container Images for workload specs
Terraform Template stores/references build artifacts used in IaC

ContainerImage.description: A container image in the common data layer, instantiated by Container Workloads and carrying CVE metadata from Concert

relationships.description: Container Image instantiates Container Workloads
Cross-product: Container Image has associated CVEs managed by Concert
Cross-product: Container Image is produced from Concert Build Artifacts

ContainerWorkload.description: A running container workload (e.g., a Kubernetes Pod deployment) in the core infrastructure model

relationships.description: Container Workload is instantiated from a Container Image
Container Workload surfaces a Service
Container Workload corresponds to a Pod
Cross-product: Turbonomic Optimization Actions act on Container Workloads
Cross-product: Instana emits Metrics from Container Workloads

Service.description: A network-accessible service entity in the core infrastructure model, surfaced by container workloads

relationships.description: Service is surfaced from Container Workloads
Cross-product: Service composes an Instana Application
Cross-product: Service composes a Turbonomic Application

Cluster.description: A Kubernetes or cloud cluster resource in the core infrastructure model

relationships.description: Cluster contains Nodes
Cluster contains Namespaces
Cross-product: Cluster is governed by a Terraform Template

Node.description: A compute node within a cluster, hosting Pods and Container Workloads

relationships.description: Node belongs to a Cluster
Node hosts Pods

Pod.description: A Kubernetes Pod resource, grouping one or more containers scheduled on a node

relationships.description: Pod runs on a Node
Pod belongs to a Namespace
Pod corresponds to a Container Workload

Namespace.description: A Kubernetes Namespace providing logical isolation within a Cluster

relationships.description: Namespace belongs to a Cluster
Namespace contains Pods
Namespace contains Deployments

Deployment.description: A Kubernetes Deployment resource managing the desired state of Container Workloads

relationships.description: Deployment belongs to a Namespace
Deployment manages Pods
Deployment references a Container Image

Volume.description: A persistent storage volume in the core infrastructure model, provisioned for Container Workloads

relationships.description: Volume is mounted by a Container Workload

AccessPoint.description: A network access point (load balancer, ingress rule) exposing services in the core infrastructure model

relationships.description: Access Point exposes a Service
Cross-product: Access Points are scoped to Concert Environments
